capabilities: Manages tasks with priorities and repetition.
Visualizes projects using Gantt, Kanban, and Calendar views.
Tracks note activity and provides statistics.
extras: Desktop only; not available on mobile.
problem: Users need a centralized, customizable view of their tasks, projects, and note activity immediately upon opening Obsidian.
summary: A customizable dashboard for the Obsidian home tab that aggregates tasks, projects, note activity, and countdowns into a single view.
